== Notes ==
* Can be used to cast [[hard resurrection]] spells such as [[Resurrection Chant]] quickly and with no threat of disruption.
* Combine with [[Assassin's Promise]] or [[Air of Superiority]] to bypass the extended recharge time.
{{anomaly| Despite the descriptions saying that the next spell casts ''instantly'', a better description would be ''very quickly'', as the activation time of the spell cast through it is a 1/4 second and there's still a slight chance it might be [[interrupt]]ed.}}
